summary: Evening update: the jail roster and city arrest logs could not be re-read this evening; the morning counts stand. A Pensacola man pleaded guilty in federal court to conspiring to intimidate a Baldwin County witness. Sheriff's deputies booked a woman on wrong-way DUI and methamphetamine charges early Tuesday, and made burglary, forgery and family-violence arrests later in the day. Orange Beach police made two cocaine possession arrests.

entries.title: Federal guilty plea, witness tampering: John Michael Mathurin
body: John Michael Mathurin, 33, of Pensacola, pleaded guilty Monday, Oct. 26, to conspiracy to tamper with a witness, FOX10 News reported. The witness is a Baldwin County woman; prosecutors allege associates went to a house where they believed she lived.

He also pleaded guilty to methamphetamine distribution charges, according to the report. Sentencing in the drug case is set for Nov. 12 and in the witness-tampering case for January. Three co-defendants were charged in the same tampering conspiracy indictment.

entries.title: Wrong-way DUI and methamphetamine arrest: Anne Lorraine Kossik
body: Anne Lorraine Kossik, 42, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 3:45 a.m. Tuesday, Oct. 27, and booked into the county jail, according to the jail roster.

She was booked on charges of driving under the influence of alcohol, driving on the wrong side of the highway, possession of methamphetamine, second-offense marijuana possession and first-offense drug paraphernalia. The roster shows she was released the same day.

entries.title: Burglary arrest: Rodolfo Zuniga
body: Rodolfo Zuniga, 55, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 10:14 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 27, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on a burglary charge listed as non-residence, no force — entering a building other than a home to commit a crime, without forced entry. The roster shows he was released Wednesday, Oct. 28.

entries.title: Forged instrument and theft arrest: Brandi Nicole Womack
body: Brandi Nicole Womack, 41, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 8:46 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 27, according to the jail roster.

She was booked on charges of criminal possession of a forged instrument, third degree — holding a forged document or check knowing it is forged — and theft from a public building. The roster shows she was released Wednesday, Oct. 28.

entries.title: Drug and evidence-tampering arrest, Foley: Ralph Walter Edward McMillan
body: Ralph Walter Edward McMillan, 47, was arrested by Foley police at 8:45 p.m. Monday, Oct. 26, and booked into the county jail Tuesday, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on charges of tampering with physical evidence — destroying or hiding evidence — possession of dangerous drugs and first-offense drug paraphernalia. He was in custody when the roster was read Wednesday morning.

entries.title: Orange Beach: two cocaine possession arrests
body: Orange Beach police made two arrests on cocaine possession charges in the past day, according to the county jail roster.

Justin C. Stritzinger, 26, was arrested at 12:27 a.m. Tuesday, Oct. 27, and Taylor Jade Bennett, 22, at 12:22 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28, though the roster lists her booking date as Oct. 27. Each was booked on charges of cocaine possession and first-offense drug paraphernalia. Both were in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Family-violence arrests: Cara Michelle Wood, Darris O'Neil Grace
body: Sheriff's deputies made two arrests on family-violence charges Tuesday, Oct. 27, according to the jail roster.

Cara Michelle Wood, 43, was arrested at 9:45 a.m. and booked on charges of simple assault against a family or household member and obstructing governmental operations. Darris O'Neil Grace, 30, was arrested at 10:30 a.m. and booked on charges of harassment of a family or household member and obstructing governmental operations. Both were in custody when the roster was read Wednesday morning.

entries.title: Missing person: sheriff's office seeks Miles Cubbage, 18
body: The Baldwin County Sheriff's Office asked Tuesday for help finding Miles Cubbage, 18, who it says was last seen on or around Aug. 31 at Job Corps in Montgomery and may be in the Bay Minette area.
Anyone with information is asked to call the sheriff's office at 251-937-0202.
